checks: Both HTTP create routes reject missing/partial and cross-owner refs; exact viewed revision succeeds
Stale direct revision stays 409 even with historical acknowledgement; exact request retry preserves old payload
Hard restart preserves immutable bindings and exactly one object per request; versioned source-omitting watch edit succeeds

regressions: Missing and partial direct bindings reject without writes (422)
Complete stale bindings reject (409), including historical acknowledgement
Unavailable and cross-owner dataset IDs remain 404
Strict finite positive safe-integer revision and SHA256 hash validation
Independent SQLite writer cannot interleave between source resolution and business insert
Real rendered forms retain viewed revision across global state refresh and reject unbound submissions before I/O
Exact idempotent retries keep original IDs and provenance after revision and hard restart
Data-less manual actions, immutable report/action/alert/message sources, and source-omitting versioned watch edits remain supported
Legacy read-only history is not rewritten or backfilled
not_covered_by_this_record: Native browser navigation and cookie/CSP integration
database_migration: None: new write admission only; historical stored payloads remain unchanged
